    tokens = word_tokenize(sentence)
    spans = []
    
    for i in range(len(tokens)):
        if tokens[i].lower() == 'yes':
            spans.append((i, i+1))
        elif tokens[i].lower() == 'not' and i > 0 and tokens[i-1].lower() =='some':
            spans.append((i-1, i+1))
        elif tokens[i].lower() == 'that' and (i > 0 and tokens[i-1].lower() == 'the' or i > 1 and tokens[i-2].lower() == 'the'):
            spans.append((i-1, i+1))
        elif tokens[i].lower() =='my' and i > 0 and tokens[i-1].lower() == 'hope':
            spans.append((i-1, i+1))
        elif tokens[i].lower() == 'we' and (i > 0 and tokens[i-1].lower() == 'have' or i > 1 and tokens[i-2].lower() == 'have'):
            spans.append((i-1, i+1))
            
    tagged_sentence = ''
    start = 0
    
    for end in sorted(spans):
        if start!= end[0]:
            tagged_sentence += sentence[start:end[0]] +''
        if spans.index(end) % 2 == 0:
            tagged_sentence += '<claim>' + sentence[end[0]:end[1]] + '</claim>'
        else:
            tagged_sentence += '<premise>' + sentence[end[0]:end[1]] + '</premise>'
        start = end[1]
        
    if start!= len(sentence):
        tagged_sentence += sentence[start:]
        
    return tagged_sentence.strip()

        start = end + len(span)
